summary:
Implemented `establish-bff-layer`. Added a typed landing-page content contract, a `/api/landing` Next.js route handler, a typed server-side landing content client with normalization/fallback behavior, and an App Router loading fallback. Rewired the home page to render from the typed BFF data path instead of component-local constants. Added Playwright spec coverage for the BFF endpoint and page consumption for the controller/local runner to execute later. Non-browser verification passed: `npm run lint`, `npm exec tsc -- --noEmit --incremental false`, and `npm run build`; build output includes `/api/landing`. Browser verification remains pending the approved local Playwright runner.

Approved local Playwright runner failed (exit 1). No passing browser result is claimed. Inspect the test errors and output in .ai_factory/tests/reports/local-runner/e24f1813-1cc3-4f3a-abf2-b0c7497699ef/stories-2-delivery-1-build-1-caf6ce7d-a426-49cc-8e79-8f0914c9b4c8.json.
